protocol.normalization: mean over accepted rows; zero loss on rejected rows
protocol.training: Two unrestricted T1 first-token samples; choose uniformly among correct samples; reject all-failure groups; all weights FP32 plain SGD; same batch32 forward/backward computation for both sources.
protocol.data: Class-uniform IID stream conditional on excluding both exact-input held-out cohorts. Incidental training repeats retained. Final-test labels/inputs never enter learning, rate selection, or stopping.
protocol.selection: Pilot: lowest trapezoidal mean log monitoring-error over log steps128..1024 independently for each source among complete trajectories. All rates retained.
protocol.analysis: Matched candidate error ratios at512,1024,2048,4096 and crossing budgets for errors .1,.05,.02,.01,.005,.002. Paired seed/question bootstrap. Report accepted-example axis, rate sensitivity, greedy error and local exponents.
protocol.stationarity: From64 updates, latest4 positive checks: stop if either absolute log-error or log-accepted-NLL slope < .02; abort degradation>.15 or valid mass<.95.
protocol.resources: Institutional gpu_lowp; no paid API or rental; full resume and async durable checkpoint moves.

selection.selection_scope: Best of the same three predeclared rates for each source, not a claim of global optimizer optimality.
selection.analytical_changes: Bootstrap common whole held-out questions within the designed answer strata. No change to learner, task or test budget based on confirmation outcomes.

strict_test.bootstrap_design: Resample training seeds and common whole questions within answer strata; preserve method/checkpoint pairing and the designed class balance.

original_test.bootstrap_design: Resample training seeds and common whole questions within answer strata; preserve method/checkpoint pairing and the designed class balance.

monitor.bootstrap_design: Resample training seeds and common whole questions within answer strata; preserve method/checkpoint pairing and the designed class balance.

strict_test_definition.rule: Retain every original final-test question absent from all r5s pilot training and pilot rate-selection monitoring. Select by literal IDs only, without any final-test model outputs. Also disjoint from all confirmation training and monitoring by the original split.
strict_test_definition.estimator: Equal-weight mean of the three class-conditional means. Bootstrap common whole questions within each answer class, and paired training seeds. No downsampling or outcome-based exclusion.
strict_test_definition.timing: Added after the first two confirmation pairs reached about256 monitoring updates. No final-test model predictions existed or were read. Original4095-question pool and all original analyses remain retained alongside this stricter validation.
strict_test_definition.scope: This is a clean holdout within batch r5s, not a claim that similar counting inputs were absent from pretraining or earlier project explorations.

gain_prediction.status: Secondary mechanism hypothesis, formed after the pilot and early confirmation monitoring; only initial probabilities enter the numeric coefficient.
gain_prediction.future_comparison: Report error ratios at2048 and4096 and threshold crossing ratios alongside this eventual prefactor. Finite-time deviations or different local exponents do not validate an asymptotic match. No coefficient is refit after those endpoints.
gain_prediction.assumptions: Balanced independent latent learning modes with identical logit metrics, representatively distributed like the initial monitoring probabilities. A mode may contain many literal inputs. Treating each held-out literal input as a separate one-hot feature would not generalize across the split; this is not that model.
gain_prediction.limits: This approximation ignores LLM weight sharing and mode interactions. The bootstrap measures initial-input uncertainty under the formula, not model misspecification or uncertainty in the real LLM speedup.

toy_prediction.assumptions: Equal-frequency independent Bernoulli modes; accepted-mean SGD; same eta; large-time population limit. No LLM exponent or amplitude is fitted or asserted.

toy_check.audit_status: The finite toy was a short fixed-horizon simulation; this retrospective audit verifies that none of its recorded eligible checkpoints had stationary mean error or expected accepted-target loss.

audit.scope: Accepted-example and hypothetical skipped-rejection token-work axes are secondary; matching accepted examples also changes optimizer update count.

budgets.interpretation: Candidate and actual-work budgets match exactly by design. The skipped-rejection proxy assumes a hypothetical optimized filter implementation. Accepted-count matching also changes optimizer step count. All secondary crossing ratios below are descriptive, without a new confidence interval.

geometry.status: Exploratory read-only diagnostic on pilot checkpoints; no final confirmation test data or learner updates used.

bias_probe.status: Exploratory fixed-feature diagnostic using only already exposed pilot training/monitoring inputs. No confirmation final-test questions or model outputs read.
bias_probe.method: Fit two relative global answer-logit biases by convex cross-entropy Newton optimization; hold pretrained transformer fixed. Grant a vocabulary restricted to0/1/2. This is a calibration control, not an exhaustive maximum-greedy-accuracy bound or the actual full-weight learner.

bias_bound.proof: Any globally biased multiclass predictor induces one threshold in each pairwise logit difference. Pairwise minimum errors are necessary errors even if the third answer is ignored. Global errors are at least every pair's minimum, and at least half their sum because one wrong example belongs to only two pairs. Equal-score groups move together, so ties do not create spurious attainable thresholds.
bias_bound.scope: A deterministic bound on the already exposed pilot monitoring cohort, allowing arbitrary constant answer biases and an optimistic restriction to answers0/1/2. It excludes global-prior correction as a complete explanation; it does not prove that hidden features must change rather than an input-dependent readout.

toy_weight_laws.status: Analytic reduction checked retrospectively on the already stored population trajectories; no coefficient fit.

analysis_addendum.status: Secondary discrete-budget comparisons were added using already observed monitoring curves. Final-test jobs had started, but no final-test predictions had been read by this analysis when these choices were made. All listed comparisons will be reported.
analysis_addendum.interpolation_limit: Bootstrap crossing intervals measure seed/question uncertainty, not interpolation error between sparse stored checkpoints. Direct budget comparisons avoid interpolation.

slope_diagnostic.status: Post-hoc descriptive diagnostic; no new training, test examples, model selection or bootstrap draws.
slope_diagnostic.interpretation: For two exact power laws, the log-ratio slope equals current exponent minus frozen exponent. An increasing ratio supports a finite-range exponent difference. It does not distinguish a persistent exponent gap from a transient. The confidence bands are the previously computed pointwise paired bootstrap intervals, not a simultaneous test of constant ratios.

protocol.status: Constructive theory developed after the LLM results, not an LLM fit or a prospective LLM forecast.
protocol.numerics: Composite Gauss-Legendre difficulty integrals, then dt/dtheta=1/drift. Repeat with doubled theta spacing and half quadrature order.
protocol.population_time: t = learning rate times updates; proportional to candidate budget at fixed batch and learning rate. Numerical integration does not execute t updates.

shared_skill_compatibility.scope: Post-hoc descriptive check on already used monitoring questions, with no new training, evaluations or test-cohort access.
shared_skill_compatibility.prediction: A literal one-skill additive-logit model preserves every question's probability rank and has a common logit improvement. This prediction fails in the LLM; it does not rule out multiple shared skills or establish a causal mechanism.
shared_skill_compatibility.probability_saturation: Exact probabilities of one are omitted only from logit-change summaries, with finite-pair counts reported. Rank correlations retain every question.
